title: Filing: South Korean authorities conducted an on-site search of Chinese chipmaker Montage's offices in connection with potential competition law violations (Nikita Maria Jino/Reuters)
summary: Nikita Maria Jino / Reuters: Filing: South Korean authorities conducted an on-site search of Chinese chipmaker Montage's offices in connection with potential competition law violations — South Korean authorities have conducted an on-site search and seizure at the local office of Montage Technology (688008.SS) …
